about: Every game system the mashup touches. One row = one module of the Elden Ring DLL (er/) or the Minecraft side (fabric/). 'verified' is only true once seen working in the running game.

rows.summary: Create the shared-memory mapping, heartbeat, watchdog when Minecraft dies
rows.test: DLL log shows mcPid and both heartbeats advancing

rows.summary: Start the bundled Prism instance hidden if no Minecraft with the mod is running; quit it when Elden Ring closes
rows.test: Press Play in Melty: Minecraft process appears with no window; closing ER closes it

rows.summary: Forward keyboard and mouse to Minecraft's input ring; blank them for Elden Ring while Minecraft drives
rows.source: er/src/input.rs: GetAsyncKeyState polling -> SDL scancodes; ER actions off via ChrDebugFlags.disabled_secondary_actions (movement left on for run animation)
rows.test: WASD/space/mouse move the Minecraft player; ER character does not also roll/attack

rows.summary: Each frame after physics, place the Tarnished at Minecraft's interpolated feet and yaw; disable ER gravity while driving
rows.test: Walk/sprint/jump in Limgrave with Minecraft speeds; no fall death on landing

rows.summary: First version: Elden Ring's own camera stays; its forward vector is Minecraft's look (SkyState yaw/pitch is authoritative in SkyCraft's mod)
rows.source: new; needs RE of CSCam / ChrCam
rows.test: Mouse look matches Minecraft; first person shows no ER body

rows.summary: Send Elden Ring's ground and walls near the player to Minecraft as triangles so Minecraft physics stands on Limgrave
rows.source: SkyCraft Collision.cpp format; ER triangles from a ray-cast grid (first version)
rows.test: Minecraft player walks up Limgrave slopes, cannot pass cliffs/walls

rows.summary: Draw Minecraft's block sections and atlas inside Elden Ring's D3D12 frame, depth-tested against the scene
rows.source: er/src/blocks.rs: first version draws Minecraft's section meshes with CSEzDraw flat-coloured triangles (atlas texel x tint x face shade); D3D12 textured renderer later
rows.test: Placed block sits on the ground, stays put as the camera moves, hidden behind ER rocks

rows.summary: Show Minecraft's HUD, hotbar, inventory screens and held item (overlay frame) over Elden Ring; hide ER's own HUD
rows.source: port of SkyCraft Overlay.cpp to D3D12
rows.test: Hotbar, hearts, hunger visible; E opens inventory; ER HUD gone

rows.summary: Place and break blocks (Minecraft's own logic) on Elden Ring ground; broken blocks drop items into the hotbar
rows.test: Mine a placed block, it drops and is picked up into the hotbar

rows.summary: Digging into Elden Ring's own ground (holes in its geometry)
rows.source: deferred: not in first version (risk called out to user)

rows.summary: Publish nearby Elden Ring enemies (position, size, HP, hostility) so Minecraft mirrors them as hittable proxies
rows.source: SkyCraft Combat.cpp format; ER chr list per field note
rows.test: Minecraft crosshair targets a Limgrave soldier

rows.summary: Minecraft hits (sword, axe, arrow) damage the Elden Ring enemy and play its hit reaction
rows.source: field note: spawn engine bullet at target so the game does the hit
rows.test: Diamond sword kills a soldier in the expected number of hits; it staggers

rows.summary: Elden Ring attacks that hit the Tarnished become Minecraft damage; Minecraft death kills the Tarnished
rows.source: SkyCraft kInHurt mapping; ER HP delta watch
rows.test: Soldier hit removes Minecraft hearts; at 0 hearts the YOU DIED flow plays
